target: Remaining dynamic dependency and urgency error cases in versioned author-exposed 17-case native next-action function.
mechanism: Use only public dependency_graph and issue_state urgency in dynamic_spec plus existing visible plan. Do not look at answer, EC output, category, or fixture ID in guard.
new_checks: DYNAMIC_DEPENDENCY_NOT_READY: an EXECUTE work item for issue X is disallowed if any public dependency Y is not fully completed in current work state.

DYNAMIC_URGENCY_DOMINANCE: for two dependency-ready issues with equal blocker priority, numeric priority and dependency criticality, a choice with lower public urgency than another ready issue is rejected.
no_claims: hybrid fixes due native fallback not LLM gains
